3 Waterfalls You Can Drive To 📌

From the north coast to the south. Save it for your trip.

1. Dunn's River Falls: Climb the falls hand in hand, right on the beach. (about 1h 30 from MBJ)
2. Reach Falls: Turquoise pools in the Portland rainforest. (about 40 min from Port Antonio)
3. Blue Hole: Deep blue pools and jumps in the hills. (about 20 min from Ocho Rios)
